citations.quote: If there was no inflation or deflation with respect to inventory costs and thus unit costs were unchanged, the choice of inventory valuation method would be irrelevant.
Because the cost of a kg of soap declined over the period, LIFO had the highest ending inventory amount, the lowest cost of sales, and the highest gross profit.
Based on Rules Principles Inventory valuation FIFO, LIFO and Weighted Average Method.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Laying out FIFO / LIFO / weighted-average-cost methods under IFRS / US GAAP. LIFO is US-GAAP only; the rising-price ranking inverts COGS vs ending inventory under FIFO and LIFO. The LIFO-reserve disclosure enables FIFO-equivalent conversion for peer comparison.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Inventory Cost Methods
